tagline.en: A blue harbour, white sails and a surfboard or ten.
tagline.he: מפרץ כחול, מפרשים לבנים ועשרה גלשנים.

wardrobe: a plain yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, bare feet

item.en: a tall white lifeguard chair with a red and yellow umbrella
item.he: כיסא מציל לבן וגבוה עם שמשייה אדומה וצהובה

success.en: The lifeguard did not see me!
You found me! It is shady down here.
I can see the whole beach from here.

targets.action: The child is crouching under the lifeguard chair between its front legs, one hand holding a leg, peeking out at the beach.
targets.expression: mischievous and delighted, eyes wide, mid-giggle, as if about to be spotted

hintText.en: Look between the legs of the tall white chair.
hintText.he: חפשו בין הרגליים של הכיסא הלבן הגבוה.

placement.support: Crouching on the sand between the front legs of the lifeguard chair, under its platform; both feet on the sand.
placement.occlusion: The chair's white legs and cross-braces may overlap her where they cross; nothing else is in front of her, and the platform above her head stays where it is.
placement.instructions: Crouch under the lifeguard chair between its front legs, one hand holding a leg, facing the viewer with the whole face showing between the braces. Keep the chair, its legs, braces and platform exactly as they are; the child is small enough to fit under the platform.

contract.comparators: the boy sitting on the sand at the left of the chair and the lifeguard seated on it

targets.action: The child is standing between the surfboards, looking at the nearest surfboard.
targets.expression: a small, easy smile, looking at the surfboard

item.en: surfboards standing upright in a row on the sand

success.en: You found me! The sand is hot.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on clear sand immediately in front of the upright surfboard row.
placement.occlusion: None; the child stands in front of the boards with the full body and face visible.
placement.instructions: Stand front-facing with relaxed arms in front of the orange surfboard. Use about the same scale as the nearby red-shirt child, slightly larger for the lower position.

hintText.en: Look at the boards on the right.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind the harbour rocks

item.en: big pale rocks at the edge of the harbour with rock pools
item.he: סלעים בהירים גדולים בקצה המפרץ עם שלוליות

success.en: There was a crab in there!
You found me! Look in the pool.

hintText.en: Look at the rocks on the right.

artNotes: the white shell roofs of the opera house
green and yellow ferries crossing the harbour
surfboards standing in a row on the sand
cockatoos stealing chips from a table
lifeguards on a tall wooden chair

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Sydney!

label.en: A crab in a rock pool
